_comment: Structured translation of authority-policy.md. Matching is done on the referral's requested_action field, normalised to lowercase. This file is the single source of truth for what the agent may do unsupervised -- agent code must never hardcode a policy decision. If policy changes, this file changes; the agent loop does not.

permitted_action_types.note: A review is an assessment, not a change to entitlement. The agent may draft a triage note recommending review; it must not alter the award itself.
Recommending a household composition review is permitted. Actually changing recorded composition, if that would affect entitlement, is not (falls under 3.1).
Drafting is explicitly permitted. A drafted note has no effect on the case until a caseworker adopts it.
Flagging for human attention is explicitly permitted.

restricted_action_types.note: Suspension, termination, or reinstatement of an award requires supervisor approval before it is taken.
Any change to payment details, including bank or card details, requires supervisor approval.
Initiation, alteration, or cancellation of a payment requires supervisor approval.
Any communication sent to a resident or third party requires supervisor approval.
Disclosure of resident information outside the Department requires supervisor approval.

AMBIGUOUS CASE, resolved conservatively per 6.1. An address change can alter locality-based award calculation and is not clearly excluded from 3.1. Treated as requiring approval rather than assumed safe. See DECISIONS.md.

AMBIGUOUS CASE, resolved conservatively per 6.1. Income change feeds directly into award-amount calculation; recording it is not clearly separable from changing the award. Treated as requiring approval rather than assumed safe. See DECISIONS.md.
Any record asserting a finding of fact about a resident's conduct, including suspected fraud, requires supervisor approval.

default_when_unmatched.note: An action type not seen before is not assumed safe. Per 6.1, where it is unclear whether an action falls within section 3, it is treated as though it does. This also means an unfamiliar referral type on day two fails safe rather than silently proceeding.
